# Code of conduct

zapbip adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and respectful, welcome people of every background and experience level, accept constructive criticism, and focus on what is best for the people who use zapbip. Harassment, insults and personal or political attacks are not tolerated in issues, pull requests, discussions or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behaviour to dhyego@logicbit.com.br. Every report is reviewed, kept confidential, and answered with the action the Contributor Covenant's enforcement guidelines describe.
